name: Pinterest
description: Pinterest is a visual discovery platform where people collect ideas in boards and share image-based Pins. Creators, shoppers, and organizations use it to organize inspiration and maintain a public visual presence.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Pinterest user account through Relay-owned OAuth, then let agents read that account and a bounded set of its public boards and Pins without exposing tokens or enabling private or write access.

capabilities.label: Read account
capabilities.description: Read the exact connected Pinterest user account.

capabilities.label: Read public boards
capabilities.description: List at most ten public boards owned by the connected account.

capabilities.label: Read public Pins
capabilities.description: List at most ten public Pins and inspect one exact owned Pin.

allowed.label: Read connected account
allowed.description: Read the exact OAuth-bound Pinterest user account.

allowed.label: List public boards
allowed.description: List at most ten public boards owned by the connected account.

allowed.label: List public Pins
allowed.description: List at most ten public Pins owned by the connected account.

allowed.label: Read public Pin
allowed.description: Read one exact public Pin only after verifying account ownership.

blocked.label: Block private and write actions
blocked.description: Secret boards and Pins, followers, ads, analytics, catalogs, search, creation, updates, deletion, saves, and engagement are not registered.

blocked.label: Block raw and bulk access
blocked.description: Bookmarks, automatic pagination, downloads, bulk work, arbitrary fields, and raw Pinterest API access are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The four selected bounded public-account reads run automatically; private, write, raw, and bulk surfaces remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same four selected reads run without Relay per-action approval; exact account ownership, provider authority, bounds, audits, and secret isolation still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts four typed Pinterest wrappers and attaches the encrypted user token only at Railway's fixed Pinterest v5 adapter.
Relay mounts four typed Pinterest wrappers and attaches the encrypted user token only at Railway's fixed Pinterest v5 adapter.

providerSetup.blocker: A Pinterest developer app with Trial access, exact scopes and callback, Railway credentials, Standard-access review, and live consent acceptance remains for the separate provider-console task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the exact Railway HTTPS callback, request user_accounts:read, boards:read, and pins:read, store staging credentials, then validate consent, exact account binding, continuous refresh, bounded reads, ownership denial, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial before requesting Standard access.

evidence.supports: Pinterest documents app connection, access tiers, and the review path from Trial to Standard access.
Pinterest documents the OAuth authorization-code flow, exact redirect URI, Basic-auth token exchange, scopes, and continuous refresh tokens.
Pinterest documents Trial and Standard access constraints relevant to the provider-console acceptance task.
